note: Adjudicated accidental and house-orthography variants. The witnesses agree on the substantive text.

adjudicated.ruling: The approved Benziger printing p. 348 has a full stop before the next verse. The digital witness has a comma; its actual punctuation is retained as a witness reading, not silently substituted into the controlling text.
The approved Benziger printing's spelling is retained under the house orthography. The witness reading is the same word in another editorial spelling.
